note: Based on recorded events; coverage is more limited before the year 2000. Longer historical trends may partly reflect reporting improvements.
title: Decadal average: Annual number of people affected by wildfires
subtitle: The total number of people affected is the sum of those injured, requiring assistance, and left homeless. Decadal figures are measured as the annual average over the subsequent ten-year period.
